writers.description: One row per (artifact path pattern, agent that may write it). An artifact with two writers gets two rows.

path.description: Path or glob exactly as written in the source, e.g. 'src/main/**'. For non-file artifacts (e.g. deployments), a short name.

kind.description: 'files' if this is a path in the repository; 'non-file' for things like deployments or cloud resources.

agent.description: The agent you believe is meant, as named in its .claude/agents/<name>.md frontmatter. Same as name_as_written when they match exactly.

role.description: owner = the main owner; co-writer = also writes it with no stated limit; limited-writer = may write only under a stated condition.

condition.description: The stated limit for limited-writer (e.g. 'version bumps, ledger vals only'); empty string otherwise.

source_file.description: File where this ownership is stated, relative to the repo root.

quote.description: A short EXACT substring of that line that states this writer (copy it character for character).

name_as_written.description: The writer's name EXACTLY as it appears in the cited line (e.g. 'implementer' or 'oncall-agent'), even if no agent has that name. Never corrected.

notes.description: Anything ambiguous about ownership that a human should look at. Empty if none.
